answer: Because the timing is logged against the shale challenge, the ledge audit can replay the harbor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 305 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A scripted farm thus has to pad 90 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
